parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the pipeline reports a Jaccard similarity of ~0.78, the two methods belong to distinct test classes (`PlayerControllerBehaviorTests` and `StopBehaviorTests`) and exercise semantically different behaviours — idempotency of repeated stop calls versus the ability to resume playback after a stop. Near-structural similarity in test helpers or setup/teardown scaffolding is expected and intentional; collapsing them would obscure the distinct behavioural intent each test encodes.
